name: Strande (Germany)
description: Blue field charged with the figures of the municipal arms of Strande: a white sail beside a buoy marked in yellow, red and white, above a white wavy line.
history: Municipal flag of Strande; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: buoy with red and white markings
